I. Mihi vero, Timothee, nihil tua præsentia gra-
tius fuisset aut optatiùs.
II. Etenim cum absens tantopere tuis me literis
recrearis; facile quid coràm, & consolando, & do-
lendo æque, præstare potueris intelligo.
III. Fuerunt profecto humanitatis illæ & bene-
volentiæ in me tuæ plenæ: prudentia atque doctrina
tinctæ singulari: omnia deniq; continuerunt ea, quæ
adversa fractum fortuna erigere atque confirmare
possunt.

page.notes: The accent over the e in "ftédat" (ostendat) is doubtful; the word is split across the line end after "o-". The marginal note is set in small italic and is transcribed as one note. The word "dolendo" is read from a hyphenated line end.
